python_code:
from src.nodes.base import BaseNode
from src.runtime.lighting import get_lighting_mood_engine
import json

class Hou_Mcp_Lighting_Mood(BaseNode):
    name = "hou_mcp_lighting_mood"

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-START]
        self.add_input("action",      "string", widget_type="text", default="infer")
        self.add_input("intent_text", "string", widget_type="text", default="")
        self.add_input("mood",        "string", widget_type="text", default="")
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-END]
        self.add_output("result_json", "string")
        self.add_output("mood",        "string")

    async def execute(self, inputs):
        action      = str(inputs.get("action",      "infer") or "infer").lower().strip()
        intent_text = str(inputs.get("intent_text", "") or "")
        mood        = str(inputs.get("mood",        "") or "")
        try:
            engine = get_lighting_mood_engine()
            if action == "profile":
                profile = engine.build_mood_profile(mood)
                result  = profile.to_dict()
                out_mood = profile.mood
            elif action == "list":
                moods  = engine.list_moods()
                result = moods
                out_mood = ""
            else:  # infer
                out_mood = engine.infer_mood(intent_text)
                profile  = engine.build_mood_profile(out_mood) if out_mood else None
                result   = profile.to_dict() if profile else {"mood": out_mood}
            self.log_info(f"Lighting mood action={action}: mood={out_mood}.")
            return {
                "result_json": json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True, default=str),
                "mood":        out_mood,
                "exec_out":    True,
            }
        except Exception as exc:
            self.log_error(f"Lighting mood action failed: {exc}")
            return {"result_json": "{}", "mood": "", "exec_out": True}

def register_node():
    return Hou_Mcp_Lighting_Mood
